text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after telling Hishi Akebono to 
take the day off, I dozed off while 
working in the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—...All doooone♪ Mmm~... It looks so 
delicious~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The aroma of dashi broth tickling the 
nostrils... Almost like something out of a 
storybook, it brought to mind the warmth 
of a family gathered together—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Good morning☆ You were 
sleeping like a log~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here's some chanko for my Trainer working 
so hard late into the night~. Thanks for 
everything you do for me~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hot pot was indeed right in front of 
them. While deeply grateful for it—
choice_data_list: Why are there two hot pots...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's already late, isn't it? I 
really want you to eat a whole bunch 
without holding back, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I thought Trainer-san might be worried 
about calories, so I made two different 
kinds~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We've got miso chanko packed with meat and 
full of dreams, and stomach-friendly salt 
chanko packed with fresh veggies!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Which one would you like to eat? I'll 
reheat whichever one's left over for the 
other dorm girls, so pick whichever you 
prefer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Salt chanko is definitely good for the 
body. Miso chanko might be fattening, but 
it seems like it'd give that much more 
energy. In this case...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wooww♪ Yeah, totally! Having a bunch of it 
is always a good thing~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I put in about 2 kilos of meat for now, 
but... We can always add more if it's not 
enough~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Build up your strength with my special 
chanko! Let's keep doing our best training 
together~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling all of Hishi Akebono's love, the 
two of us happily finished every last 
bite...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~. So vegetables are really 
important to Trainer right now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I put so much thought into wishing you 
super good health... so if you eat this 
chanko, you'll be good as new~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then let's eat before it gets cold! I'll 
serve it up~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“—And you see, this mushroom is super 
rare. The other day, I carried an old lady 
who was lost in the woods, and she shared 
some with me—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chanko nabe I ate while listening to 
her talk seemed to seep into my very 
core... and gave me the drive to give it 
my all again starting tomorrow.
